STEREOPSIS VR - depth vision test and training for PC VR
=========================================================

NOT A MEDICAL TEST. It can't diagnose anything.

1. In your headset, set the lens distance (IPD) correctly.
   Keep SteamVR's render resolution at 100% (or more).
2. Double-click "Start Stereopsis VR.cmd" (not the .exe), type a nickname,
   press Enter. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click
   More info -> Run anyway (the app is not code-signed).
3. The app opens in the headset, in the Keeper's Hut.
   Point with the controller ray, pull the trigger to choose.

Controls: trigger (or A/X) = select / continue; thumbstick = answer and scroll;
grip = bring the menu back in front of you; HOLD B or Y = stop a session.

Suggested order if you're trying it as a comparison:
  1. Stereopsis test -> Standard (about 20 minutes), before any training.
  2. Firefly Forest, one session (two nights, about 25 minutes).
  3. The Ruins, 10-15 minutes.
Then zip the folder results\<your nickname> and send it back, with your headset model.

Stop and see an eye doctor if you see double outside the headset, if headaches
or eye strain don't go away, or if anything about your vision changes.

Keep the folders "assets" and "musica" next to StereopsisVR.exe.
More: https://github.com/cyclopean-boi/Stereopsis-vr
